title: The Middle Son (Chas McIvor)
style: country blues acoustic guitar warm baritone male vocal storytelling 100bpm walking bass brushed drums honest character portrait unhurried family Perth middle son
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
There's a specific skill set that the middle son develops
In the space between the eldest and the youngest — that's the envelope
He learns to read the room before the room has read itself
He learns to make his way without the manual on the shelf

[Pre-Chorus]
Corey grew up between Pete's noise and Joel's quiet
And figured out his own thing — didn't need to advertise it

[Chorus]
The middle son, the middle son
Not the first to go and not the last one done
The middle son finds his own particular road
Between the family's history and his own chosen code
That's my boy

[Verse 2]
He watches things before he moves — that's not caution, that's intelligence
The middle son translates between the polar differences
He knows what Pete thinks before Pete thinks to say it
And he knows what Joel needs before Joel knows how to weigh it

[Bridge]
There was a time I thought the middle was the harder place to stand
Then I watched my Corey and I understood the plan
He didn't need the edge of things — he built his from the centre
The middle son is where the whole family re-enters

[Outro]
Middle son knows where he stands… Corey knows who he is…
That's my boy
